prompt: A general motors vehicle is named after the largest ward in the country of Monaco.  How many people had walked on the moon as of the first model year of the vehicle? Note: the model year is not the same as the year the model was first produced.
answer:
The vehicle is the **Chevrolet Monte Carlo**, whose first model year was **1970** (although production began in 1969).

By 1970, **four people had walked on the Moon**:

- Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin — Apollo 11, July 1969  
- Pete Conrad and Alan Bean — Apollo 12, November 1969
